title: India Condemns Embassy Vandalism in Slovenia
summary: The Indian government condemned the vandalism of its embassy in Slovenia. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that diplomatic premises are inviolable. The MEA called for action against 'anti-India' elements and demanded accountability. The incident involved the defacement of the Indian mission in Slovenia. The government reiterated its stand on the issue, strongly condemning it.
summary_points: The Indian government condemned the vandalism of its embassy in Slovenia.
The MEA stated that diplomatic premises are inviolable.
The MEA called for action against 'anti-India' elements.
The government demanded accountability for the incident.
The incident involved the defacement of the Indian mission in Slovenia.
